summary: Small car park against a large commercial building; no homes within 35 m.
reasons: Nearest dwelling about 35 m from best section

drivers.seclusion: Large commercial building on one side, industrial sheds beyond; the nearest dwellings are Verde apartments 22 m from the south end and houses over 50 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Open to Cameron Street at the south end; sealed, a few cars parked, room for a van in the north.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street with metered kerb parking; Montague Road is a short walk away.
drivers.convention: Looks like a business car park; other cars use it by day, overnight use unknown.

flags: Steep along the north end: about 4% fall from 0 to 20 m
Low-lying: lowest point about 4.4 m, Brisbane River 354 m away
Metered kerb parking signs on the nearby streets (12P, 4P Pay By App)
sun_shade: Heavily shaded by tall trees on the west side and the big building to the east.

best_section.where: North-west end of the small car park, against the big building's wall
